notes.title: Welcome to the Official Memoridian Discord!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502334/51540e4d59802179d842b984f11870b3badbeb2e.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Hey Explorers,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce the launch of the [b]official Discord server for Memoridian[/b][/p][p]Whether you're here to:[/p][list][*][p] Share theories about the world of Memoridian[/p][/*][*][p]Report bugs or suggest features[/p][/*][*][p]Show off fan art, pets, or housing builds[/p][/*][*][p]Chat with the dev (yes, that’s me!) and fellow players[/p][/*][*][p]Learn about the current development status[/p][/*][/list][p]This is your space. Built to be modular, safe, and creatively charged—just like the game itself.[/p][p]The Discord is still fresh, so let's try to build it up![/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/7G3aVb8Aqd"]Join the Discord here[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve set up clear onboarding, community rules, and channels tailored to your feedback. Whether you're a lore lover, a boss-fight strategist, or just vibing with the surreal atmosphere, there’s a place for you.[/p][p]See you inside,[/p][p]
—Jefri Cabrera[/p][p]
Creator of Memoridian[/p][hr][/hr]
